description: This file is a shell script (bash/sh) that contains a series of test cases for Git filter mechanisms, including tests for filter configuration, content filtering, delayed checkout, process filters, and various edge cases involving Git attributes and submodules. It appears to be a comprehensive test suite for a Git filtering feature, particularly oriented around custom filters like rot13, handling delayed checkouts, and process filter behaviors.

methods.name: test_delayed_checkout_progress
methods.description: A function that tests whether delayed checkout reports progress correctly depending on whether the output is a TTY or not, and depending on the --quiet and --progress flags.
